en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval clock tower with a steep shingled roof overlooking a city. The tower has a prominent round clock face with Roman numerals on its wall and is set on a hill with trees and a path in the foreground. On the right side of the card there is a printed decorative shield containing a portrait of an older, mustachioed man in a decorated military uniform, and beside the shield stands a heraldic lion with a crown. There is no visible printed caption or other text.
